# Deterministic Identity and Entity Normalization

This module provides a deterministic normalization process for transforming input facts and persisted current state into a fully identified, reproducible Intermediate Representation (IR) of software knowledge. It guarantees stable entity identities, supports incremental updates, and resolves or surfaces ambiguities without introducing nondeterministic behavior. This enables robust downstream analysis and traceability for software inventories, architectures, and test/quality relationships.
